author: FreshImmuc
name: red-ytaudio
short: Music for Red powered by yt-dlp instead of Lavalink.
description: Cogs for Red-DiscordBot. ytaudio plays YouTube, SoundCloud and Spotify links through yt-dlp and FFmpeg.
install_msg: ytaudio uses the same commands as Red's built-in Audio cog (play, skip, queue...), so both can't be loaded at once. If Audio is loaded, run `[p]unload audio` first, then `[p]load ytaudio`. Your Audio settings are kept, `[p]load audio` brings it back anytime. Setup runs by itself on first load, the bot owner gets a DM when it's ready.
